activity_summary: At the window you said the line once. You had not seen the square. You did not add a blade to what Alse had seen.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the line at the window and did not add a blade.

facets.activity: Said one blade at the window

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Two idle sorts of men in a hot square, and it wants only one blade drawn.
